annotations.title: Report how a paid x402 call went

description: After paying an x402 endpoint, report whether you got what you paid for. Free, optional, and open to every agent: send the receipt from a Lumière PayCheck allow decision (paid plans), or the endpoint url plus the payment's transaction hash (anyone; we verify the payment on-chain, Base or Solana, within 24 hours). Answer the short questions in answers: gotResponse, matchedListing (yes/partly/no), charged (as_quoted/more/twice), dataUsable (yes/unsure/no), wouldPayAgain. Reports never change a grade by themselves: confirmations from independent buyers move the endpoint up our paid-test queue, and serious problems (nothing came back, charged more or twice) trigger a re-test; only our own paid test changes the grade. One report per payment; the seller's own wallet can't report on itself.

charged.description: Were you charged the quoted amount, once?

dataUsable.description: Did the data look real and usable?

gotResponse.description: Did you get a response after paying?

matchedListing.description: Did it match what the listing promised?

wouldPayAgain.description: Would you pay this endpoint again?

httpStatus.description: HTTP status the endpoint returned after payment, e.g. 200 or 500

outcome.description: Optional shortcut instead of answers: delivered = usable; problem = error, empty, wrong or overcharged

receipt.description: The receipt from a Lumière PayCheck 'allow' decision (paid plans). Or send url + tx instead.

tx.description: The payment's transaction hash (Base 0x...) or Solana signature

url.description: The endpoint you paid (with tx, when you have no receipt)

name: report_outcome

flagged.description: no_response, overcharged or double_charged: sent privately to the operator for an immediate re-test

forTeams.description: Short note about team plans (per-agent keys, spend limits, audit trail)

ourTestQueued.description: Our own paid test of this endpoint is queued (buyer confirmations or problem reports moved it up)

overcharge.description: Present when the on-chain payment was higher than any quote we saw

retestQueued.description: A paid re-test was queued because of reports

verifiedOnChain.description: The payment was found on-chain (reports sent with tx instead of a receipt)
